one_liner: Lark Open Platform offers a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0 user authorization and tenant tokens, self-serve app creation, and an official MCP server (lark-mcp, local npm tool).
auth_notes: user_access_token via authorization-code OAuth flow with refresh tokens; tenant_access_token obtained by exchanging app_id/app_secret (app-level). Tokens are sent as Authorization: Bearer. Custom apps need admin approval of scopes within a tenant.
access_notes: Developer Console lets anyone create a custom app; works on any Lark plan including Starter (10,000 basic API calls/month cap). Scopes need tenant admin approval, which a developer can self-do in their own tenant.
blocker_notes: Minor: scopes need tenant admin approval, and Starter caps basic API calls at 10,000/month; neither blocks building. The remote MCP server mode is marked deprecated and in internal testing, but the official local lark-mcp tool remains.

evidence.quote: OAuth token API for acquiring the `user_access_token` and `refresh_token`. The `user_access_token` serves as the user's access credential, which allows API calls to be made on behalf of the user.
`tenant_access_token` **:** Tenant authorization token. With this token, the app uses its own account to perform corresponding actions
Any Lark plan, including Starter. Custom apps can call the Lark API on every plan.
The total number of basic API calls for all enterprise self-built applications under a single tenant is limited to **10,000 times per month**
lark-mcp is an MCP toolkit provided by the Lark Open Platform.
This is the Feishu/Lark official OpenAPI MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool designed to help users quickly connect to the Feishu/Lark platform
Lark Open Platform provides a remote MCP Server configuration feature that supports the Streamable HTTP transmission protocol
